scares.description: Ryan looks back at the road and screams upon seeing an armadillo.
A laughing skull toy on a cane appears at the window next to Michelle.
Michelle gets back up and sees Leatherface right in front of her.
The girl turns around and runs into Leatherface.
Leatherface leaps out of the water and grabs Michelle.
The man reaches in through the car window and grabs Michelle from behind.

title: Leatherface The Texas Chainsaw Massacre Iii
